title: Delete a shipment and review stock consequences
steps: Inspect the loaded Desk lamp Stock tab and its physical stock.
Open Full list and scroll right to inspect the opening stock and shipment movement, including its Origin and Qty.
Follow the SH-DISPATCH Origin link and inspect the shipment with Processed status.
Click Delete and inspect the warning and the editable Restore stock on deletion choice.
Explicitly leave stock restoration unselected and click Yes to delete the shipment.
Open Products | Services, follow DISPATCH-LAMP from the recent stock movements, and open its Stock tab.
Open Full list and scroll right to inspect the remaining stock movements and their Origin cells.
Re-establish the same isolated closed shipment and 15-unit stock fixture for the supplemental restoration branch.
Open the product Stock tab, open Full list, and follow the SH-DISPATCH Origin link.
Click Delete, inspect the warning, select Restore stock on deletion, and confirm Yes.
Return through Products | Services to the product Stock tab, then open Full list and inspect the stock movements.

video_guide.summary: Compare both stock-restoration choices: the dialog explains existing movements; the first choice retains stock 15 and the second restores stock 20.

chapters.note: The movement list shows opening stock +20 and shipment -5 with its Origin link.
The deletion dialog warns that keeping the stock decrease removes its source shipment. Restore stock on deletion is unchecked.
After deletion without restoration, physical stock is 15.
The second scenario starts with the same product showing physical stock 15.
Restore stock on deletion is checked and the consequence warning remains visible.
After deletion with restoration, physical stock is 20.
The movement list shows a compensating +5, the earlier -5, and opening stock +20.
